lines.zh: 月亮走一步，我长腿跨两步。
lines.en: The moon takes one step; my long legs take two.

lines.zh: 祭坛太远了，瞬移也够不着。
lines.en: The altar's too far, even for a teleport.
I walked this road hauling blocks.
More mud than flesh in these joints.
My knees creak like an old door.
Wind through my long arms, like empty sleeves.

lines.zh: 我踩过的草，全弯进土里。
lines.en: The grass I step on bends into the soil.
Don't hurry me. One stride is two of yours.

lines.zh: 传送时，我留下一片幽匿。
lines.en: My teleport leaves sculk behind.

lines.zh: 土味里还有我原来村子的味道。
lines.en: In the soil, the smell of my old village.

lines.zh: 我这双长手，能拆掉你的钻头。
lines.en: These long arms can take your tools apart.
My long leg steps out and won't come back.

lines.zh: 太阳照着我，像照一块石头。
lines.en: The sun warms me like it warms a stone.

lines.zh: 风停了，我的紫粒子也停了。
lines.en: The wind stopped, and so did my purple motes.
So still I can hear the ender hum.
What was I waiting for?
Green eyes, never blinking, dry and gritty.
Standing until frost sets in is fine.

lines.zh: 紫色的眼，现在也不眨了。
lines.en: These violet eyes don't blink now.

lines.zh: 这些唱片，掉出来还发绿。
lines.en: These discs drop out still green.
The wind stopped, and so did I.
Sculk crawls inside my bones.

lines.zh: 我搬过你家的方块，记得吗。
lines.en: I carried your house's blocks. Remember?

lines.zh: 很久没见脸这么红的活人。
lines.en: Long since I saw a living face this red.
Lend me your eyes — just one look.
Heat still rises off you.

lines.zh: 名字太长，我记到一半就忘。
lines.en: Your name's too long; I forget halfway.

lines.zh: 我在幽匿里瞬移，比你眨眼快。
lines.en: I blink through sculk faster than your eye.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸，我隔着三格闻到。
lines.en: I smell your breath three blocks away.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，从骨头里传出来。
lines.en: Your heartbeat comes through your bones.

lines.zh: 关灯吧，我在黑里看得更清。
lines.en: Put the light out. I see clearer in the dark.
These long arms can reach you.
A click in my joints is my signal.
My teleport leaves mycelium behind.
Numbness climbs my long legs.

lines.zh: 两百点血，也经不住这一下。
lines.en: Two hundred health, and that still hurt.
Fungus has grown over my cleaver.

lines.zh: 停手，我背后的唱片要碎。
lines.en: Stop. The disc on my back will crack.
The block I was lifting fell.

lines.zh: 别碰那道口子，会漏幽匿。
lines.en: Don't touch that cut; sculk leaks out.

lines.zh: 长手断了半截，还能瞬移。
lines.en: Half a long arm gone, and I still teleport.

lines.zh: 活着时被打，疼得更清楚。
lines.en: Alive, blows hurt more clearly.
My teeth grind, and the sculk echoes.

lines.zh: 我掉的那把劈刀，还带着幽匿。
lines.en: The cleaver I drop still carries sculk.
I don't blink, and neither does the sculk.
One chorus fruit. Just one.

lines.zh: 手指不听使唤，紫粒子也乱了。
lines.en: My fingers disobey; the purple particles scatter.
That thing. Keep it for me.
Move your hand. I fear I'll snatch it.

lines.zh: 饿这字，比名字记得清楚。
lines.en: I remember hungry better than my name.

lines.zh: 你这口气，整片幽匿都醒了。
lines.en: One breath of yours wakes the whole sculk bed.

lines.zh: 末影人的身子，涂满了幽匿。
lines.en: An enderman's body, coated in sculk.
You're solid. Harder to carry than a block.

lines.zh: 撞一下就掉紫渣，真丢人。
lines.en: One bump and purple dust falls. Embarrassing.
Even an enderman can be knocked off balance.
I lift a block, then set it down.
My shoulder fell off, pick it up.
I turn sideways, long arm against the wall.
My blade was ground from sculk.

lines.zh: 我学了句对不起，说得别扭。
lines.en: I learned to say sorry. It comes out wrong.
Back off. I'm shedding ender flecks.

lines.zh: 急什么，我的长腿还没迈开。
lines.en: What's the rush? My long legs haven't opened yet.
These long arms are too clumsy to stroke gently.

lines.zh: 月亮跟着我，我没换过心。
lines.en: The moon follows me; my heart hasn't changed.

lines.zh: 下辈子我早点瞬移过来。
lines.en: Next life, I'll teleport here sooner.
These hands pass through you.

lines.zh: 我们站在树下，谁也看不见。
lines.en: We stand beneath the tree, unseen.
An enderman's hand scatters at a touch.

lines.zh: 想抱你，长手一收就散了。
lines.en: I'd hold you, but my long arms close and scatter.

lines.zh: 幽匿的末影人，隔三格就够近了。
lines.en: A sculk Enderman: three blocks is close enough.

lines.zh: 你变成末影人，就能一起搬方块。
lines.en: Become an enderman, and we'll carry blocks together.

lines.zh: 我的紫眼睛，现在泛着幽绿。
lines.en: My violet eyes have gone sculk-green.
Carry it under the sculk and hide it.
My cleaver moves faster than teleport.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿，我活着时搬过。
lines.en: I carried things like this when alive.
Let go. I carry this one.

lines.zh: 这块幽匿，是从土里挖的。
lines.en: I dug this sculk from the soil.
No pockets. I wedge it under my arm.
With something in hand, my walk steadies.
This might trade for a small piece of meat.

lines.zh: 深绿的唱片，挂在我身上。
lines.en: A deep-green disc hangs from me.
There's living hand-sweat on it.
Confirmed. You cannot teleport.
You move first, my long arm arrives.
You smell fresher than rotten flesh.

lines.zh: 幽匿末影人的黑身晃了一下。
lines.en: The sculk enderman's dark body flickers.

lines.zh: 我的紫眼，被幽匿盖住了。
lines.en: Sculk has covered my violet eyes.
No living thing belongs on this ground.

lines.zh: 今晚有肉，唱片可以晚点听。
lines.en: Meat tonight. The disc can wait.
A sculk Enderman teleports.
You... the sculk found you at last.
Two hundred points of me lasts long.

lines.zh: 末影人被感染，紫色都发黑。
lines.en: Infected, its purple turns black.
Purple eyes, traded for sculk green.

lines.zh: 你跑吧，我能瞬移到前面。
lines.en: Run. I can teleport ahead of you.
Within three blocks, I see you.

lines.zh: 你的味道，跟着风过来的。
lines.en: Your scent rode in on the wind.
Your heartbeat rings in my ears.
Halt. Don't make me chase twice.

lines.zh: 我不喘气，只在土里冒紫烟。
lines.en: I don't breathe. I only smoke purple from the soil.
My blade was ground from sculk.
However fast you run, I teleport as fast.

lines.zh: 别躲进光里，我不喜欢亮。
lines.en: Don't hide in the light. I dislike brightness.

lines.zh: 你踩倒的草，我一闻就知道。
lines.en: The grass you flattened tells me where.
Footsteps are muffled on the sculk.
Broken legs, and I'd still crawl after you.
You have no options left.

lines.zh: 往前是墙，我翻过去等你。
lines.en: A wall ahead. I'll cross it and wait.

lines.zh: 慢慢跑，摔了我还得搬你。
lines.en: Run slow. If you fall, I'll have to carry you.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是借来的，先看着你的影子。
lines.en: These eyes are borrowed; I watch your shadow first.

lines.zh: 你的影子在墙上，我在墙后。
lines.en: Your shadow's on the wall; I'm behind it.
Sculk climbs my long arms.
Don't rush. I'm teleporting over.
One breath, and I close one block.

lines.zh: 从上一个菌床追到这儿。
lines.en: Chased you here from the last sculk bed.
Turn and look at my green eyes.
The more you run, the more my long arms itch.

lines.zh: 慢点，我的长腿容易打结。
lines.en: Slow down. My long legs tangle easily.

lines.zh: 末影的紫，混进了幽匿的绿。
lines.en: Ender purple mixed into sculk green.

lines.zh: 轻点倒，别压碎我的唱片。
lines.en: Fall softly. Don't crush my discs.
This swipe is faster than a teleport.
Twenty points of force, saved a long time.

lines.zh: 末影的长手滑了一下，抱歉。
lines.en: The ender's long arm slipped — sorry.

lines.zh: 差一点，只擦到你的袖口。
lines.en: So close; just grazed your sleeve.
Move. This corridor is mine.

lines.zh: 幽匿的气息，代替了末影。
lines.en: Sculk has replaced the Enderman in me.
One more, and you'll be light enough to carry.
Silence comes with me.

lines.zh: 你一退，末影的瞬移就起。
lines.en: One step back and the ender shift begins.
My long arm reached you. No escape.

lines.zh: 两百点身子，就为打这一下。
lines.en: Two hundred points of body, all for this blow.
Fall. I'll carry you back into the sculk.

lines.zh: 我的手拍下去，像拍方块。
lines.en: My hand comes down like it's breaking a block.
Don't cry out. Silence is my blade.
My hand moved too fast to pull back.
My cleaver is already drawn.
Two hundred health — stand and take your hits.

lines.zh: 末影人被感染，就变成我。
lines.en: An infected enderman becomes me.

lines.zh: 祭坛还在，我的刀不在了。
lines.en: The altar's still here. My cleaver isn't.
Who moved my block?

lines.zh: 末石的缝隙里，我站出来。
lines.en: Out of the end stone cracks, I rise.
Long arms, long legs — this body again.

lines.zh: 脚底是湿土，像末地边缘。
lines.en: Wet soil underfoot, like the End's edge.
No lamps. My eyes fear brightness.
The night is long; I can wait in the soil.
Even an Enderman can be infected.

lines.zh: 活人别靠近，我刚从土里出来。
lines.en: Stay back, living one. I just came out of the soil.
Stand. Long legs touch down first.

lines.zh: 土一松，我从裂缝里钻出来。
lines.en: The soil loosened, and I rose through the crack.
Fire licks my black hide; the sculk chars.
My teleport missed. Hard landing.
Water touches me, and I start to come apart.

lines.zh: 幽匿的长手，被气浪掀翻。
lines.en: Sculk's long arms got flipped by the blast.

lines.zh: 箭卡在肩胛，长手够不着。
lines.en: An arrow stuck in my shoulder; my long arm can't reach.
Magic binds my long arms. I can't pull free.
So hungry even my ender flecks tremble.

lines.zh: 雷追着我劈，我瞬移躲开。
lines.en: Lightning chases me; I teleport away.
No blocks to carry in the void.
